item.title: AWS Frontier Agents Review 2026: AI-Powered Security Testing and DevOps
item.description: AWS Frontier Agents reached general availability on March 31, 2026, marking the most significant expansion of Amazon’s AI portfolio since Bedrock launched in 2023. Two production-ready agents — the AWS Security Agent and the AWS DevOps Agent — are now available to all AWS customers, backed by Amazon Bedrock and powered by Claude models from Anthropic. This review covers architecture, performance benchmarks, competitive positioning against Azure AI Agent Service and Google Cloud Agent Builder, and a practical deployment guide so you can get Frontier Agents running in your own pipeline today.
